poc_scope: Environment: Dedicated pool with reserved capacity (equiv. 8x A100-80GB or q8b quantized nodes)
Tests: ramped load, sustained soak, burst/failover, regression checks vs. baseline
Metrics collected: p50/p95/p99 latency (per-model, per-route), tokens/s, requests/s, GPU utilization, error rates, cost per 1k tokens

poc_success_criteria: Latency: p95 < 450ms for 0-128 token responses under 80% sustained load
Throughput: sustain 2.5k reqs/min with median response size 120 tokens without queue growth
Soak: 48h continuous run at 60% nominal capacity without errors >0.1%
Failover: automated fallback to model-variant within 2s on simulated node loss
Cost: projected unit cost (tokens) < current self-hosted baseline or clear path with Optimize recommendations

Day 1: Baseline run vs. customer cluster (same sanitized prompts) — capture latency distribution
Day 2-3: Ramp test — linear ramp to 120% over 90 minutes; 30-minute peak hold
Day 4-5: Configuration tuning — batching, KV cache settings, quantization profile trial
Day 6-8: 48h soak run at 60% sustained throughput; mid-point checkpoint
Day 9: Failure injection — kill 1/8 nodes, verify routing/fallback and SLA behavior
Day 10-12: Long tail sampling + regression evals on critical prompt set
Day 13: Cost projection review (Optimize report) + ops handoff
planned_gpu_reservation: Requested: 8x A100-80GB equivalent (or 16x H100-40GB mixed with quantized model variants)
Justification: sustain concurrent KV-heavy chat state + reranking QPS during peak booking windows
Fallback config: scale to burst pool (extra 4 GPUs) for 15-minute windows during scheduled tests
soak_test_details: Traffic shape: steady-state 60% of nominal capacity (target 2.5k reqs/min peak equivalence)
Checks: memory leak detection, KV cache hit-rate analysis, GPU thermal/power events, error/minute tracking
Acceptance: no memory growth >10% during soak; error rate <0.1%
load_test_strategy: Ramp profile: 0 -> 120% over 90 minutes; 30-minute peak hold; graceful drop to steady-state
Burst tests: 10x short 1-minute bursts to validate autoscaling and queueing behavior
Edge-case: long-context requests (2k tokens) injected at 5% sample rate to evaluate token-limited tail latency
representative_prompts: User: I'm trying to change my flight dates. Show best rebooking options and baggage rules for a family of 4 traveling from SFO to LHR on 2026-07-15.

Long context: Given conversation history (approx. 1200 tokens), produce concise next message and identify action items.
